name: @aacn.eu/use-friendly-captcha
description: React hook and server verification helper for Friendly Captcha v1
author: AACN Software- und Systementwicklung GmbH

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --clean --sourcemap --target es2020 --external react --external friendly-challenge
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.format: prettier --write src README.md CHANGELOG.md package.json tsconfig.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/build-and-test.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src README.md CHANGELOG.md package.json tsconfig.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/build-and-test.yml
